summary: All API requests pass through the platform gateway and route by path: /api/gateway, /api/controller, /api/eda, /eda-event-streams/api/eda/v1/external_event_stream/ and /api/galaxy; monitor per-route latency in the Envoy proxy logs (proxy container on OpenShift, gateway node logs otherwise) and alert when p99 exceeds about 1500 ms.
questions: How do I find which AAP service is slow?
What API paths does the platform gateway route?
Where are platform gateway proxy logs?
What API latency threshold should trigger alerts in AAP?

answer_card.title: Find the slow service by API route
answer_card.answer_md:
| Route | Service |
|---|---|
| `/api/gateway` | Platform gateway |
| `/api/controller` | Automation controller |
| `/api/eda` | Event-Driven Ansible |
| `/eda-event-streams/api/eda/v1/external_event_stream/` | EDA event streams |
| `/api/galaxy` | Automation hub |

Check per-route latency in the Envoy proxy logs: the proxy container of the gateway pods on OpenShift, or the gateway nodes' proxy logs on VM and container installs. Alert when p99 exceeds about 1500 ms.
